newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MAS stock has muted reaction to results.
newsitem.headline: MAS stock has muted reaction to results.

text.p: Shares of national airline Malaysian Airline System Bhd (MAS) had little reaction to half-year results which fell in line with analysts' expectations, equity dealers said on Wednesday.
"MAS's results are not going to spur anyone to do anything," one dealer with a local brokerage said.

For the six months ended September 30, 1996, the airline posted net profit of 138 million ringgit, almost flat with the 139.63 million a year ago. Turnover rose 12.8 percent to 3.17 billion ringgit. The results were released late on Tuesday.
In late morning trading, MAS shares were off 10 cents to 6.50 ringgit.
"This result is within our recent revised forecast as well as market expectation," a report from Mayban Securities said on Wednesday.
The research note from Mayban said the results were affected by passenger cancellations following an outbreak of cholera in Penang earlier this year as well as a surge in jet fuel prices.
Fuel prices have risen by more than 40 percent over the 1995 level, the report said.
"Hopefully, the expected strengthening of ringgit against US dollar, greater utilisation of younger fleet as well as strategic fuel management would help to cushion the impact," Mayban said.
